title: Class-Spy
summary: Turns utility classes into readable CSS at the point of use, so developers can inspect an unfamiliar interface without breaking their flow.
challenge: Resolve CSS and Tailwind utilities consistently across HTML, React, Vue, Svelte, Astro and Angular while keeping hover feedback immediate.
decisions: Framework-aware parsing instead of one generic regex pass
AST-assisted inspection so a resolved class maps back to its source
Low-latency editor feedback — the hover card is the product
ownership: Designed and built the extension experience and parsing flow end to end.

callouts.text: The class attribute under the cursor, framework-aware.
Each utility resolved to the declaration it produces.
Status strip: frameworks covered, language, inspection state.
